title: A bulk fuel price curve with an audit above a volume
heading: The Segment Binaries Are Decisions Other Rules Can Use
cases: an order billed on the price curve is allowed, and one billed at a discount the curve does not give is refused
an order above the audit volume is allowed with an audit and refused without one
an order between the price band's start and the audit volume is allowed without an audit
an order of exactly the audit volume is allowed without an audit
